Dangerous Goods

Деревянный ящик

A solid or slatted wooden box designed for shipping and protecting heavy or large dangerous goods, as per international packaging standards.

Quick answer: A solid or slatted wooden box designed for shipping and protecting heavy or large dangerous goods, as per international packaging standards.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Деревянный ящик?

In this glossary, Деревянный ящик refers to: A solid or slatted wooden box designed for shipping and protecting heavy or large dangerous goods, as per international packaging standards.

How is Деревянный ящик used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Тяжелое оборудование, классифицируемое как опасный груз, часто перевозится в деревянных ящиках индивидуального размера для обеспечения безопасности и соответствия международным стандартам."

Why does Деревянный ящик matter in logistics?

Деревянный ящик matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Деревянный ящик?

Деревянный ящик is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Деревянный ящик belong to?

In this glossary, Деревянный ящик is grouped under Dangerous Goods. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A solid or slatted wooden box designed for shipping and protecting heavy or large dangerous goods, as per international packaging standards.

Operational example

Heavy equipment classified as dangerous goods is often shipped in custom-sized wooden crates to ensure safety and compliance with international transport standards.

Localized term
